mergeTitle: Merge my contacts with the Contacts module
mergeIntro: A person should exist only once, in the Contacts module. This page takes over your partnership contacts: those already in Contacts are simply linked, the others are created there, and each partnership file keeps the link. Nothing is deleted: your old contacts are kept as they are ("legacyContacts" copy, included in the backup) and the merge can be undone.
mergeLink: Already in Contacts: would simply be linked
mergeCreate: New: would be created in Contacts
mergeSame: Already counted above (same person on several files): linked to the same person
mergeAmbiguous: Ambiguous: to check by hand (left untouched)
mergeSettled: Already settled by a previous merge
mergeAmbHelp: When in doubt nothing is merged: these contacts stay in the kept copy and you match them yourself, from the partnership file or here once the merge is done.
mergeAmbHelpAfter: When in doubt nothing was merged. "Link" attaches the contact found; "Ignore" does not take it over (it stays in the kept copy). Otherwise link or create the right contact from the partnership file.
